answer: The protocol samples these pulses at random; an attacker running many fake identities must pay the full bond per node plus real compute to answer every challenge or forfeit stakes. Each agent must stake a juniper-branded bond and submit to a periodic pulse challenge, a signed heartbeat tied to its hardware root. Honest agents ride the same tide of rewards while sybils drown in duplicated costs, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
